age.evidence: In total, 204 8- week- old C57BL/6J male mice were purchased from Beijing Vital River Laboratory Animal Technology.

sex.evidence: In total, 204 8- week- old C57BL/6J male mice were purchased

dosing.doses_raw: the doses of psilocin were 5 mg/kg, 1 mg/kg, or 0.25 mg/kg ... In the METH- induced CPP model, the dose of METH, psilocin, TFP2HCl, and SCH772984 were 1, 1, 2, and 10 mg/kg, respectively.
dosing.evidence: Psilocin (Cayman Chemical Company) were dissolved in 0.9% saline. Single acute dose in the open-field experiments; in CPP, 'On days 3, 5, 7, and 9 ... the drug group was injected with 1 mg/kg psilocin'; 'the METH- Rein2 group was injected (i.p) with 1 mg/kg psilocin prior to METH injections'.

handling.evidence: No handling protocol described; only 'Prior to experimentation, all animals were housed for 1 week to adapt to the environment'.

group_housing.evidence: Mice were housed in four mice per cage with water and standard chow available ad libitum

day_night_flipped.evidence: 12/12 h light/dark cycle (direction/phase of testing not specified)

assays.assay_description: Activity monitored in an open field for 1 h. Three cohorts: psilocin alone (0.25, 1, 5 mg/kg); psilocin (0.25, 1 mg/kg) before METH 2 mg/kg; TFP-2HCl or SCH772984 before METH. Single measure: locomotor activity.

application_type.evidence: 1 or 0.25 mg/kg psilocin administered prior to i.p injection of METH

setup_restrain.evidence: mouse activity was monitored in an open- field for 1 h

food_restriction.evidence: Open-field test; no food described in apparatus during the 1 h recording

water_restriction.evidence: Open-field test; no water described in apparatus during the 1 h recording

time_to_assay.evidence: psilocin administered prior to i.p injection of METH (interval to open-field recording not stated)

sample_size.evidence: 24 mice were divided into four groups ... 25 mice were divided into four groups ... 36 mice were divided into six groups; Figure 1/2: n = 6- 7; Figure 8: n = 6

outcomes.summary: Psilocin alone at 5 mg/kg increased locomotor activity; 1 and 0.25 mg/kg had no effect. 1 mg/kg psilocin significantly inhibited METH-induced (2 mg/kg) hyperactivity, whereas 0.25 mg/kg did not. TFP-2HCl and SCH772984 also blocked METH hyperactivity.
outcomes.statistics: Psilocin alone: F(3,21)=5.300, p=0.007; 5 mg/kg vs control p<0.05. METH model: F(3,21)=15.32, p<0.001; METH vs control p<0.001; 1 mg/kg psilocin+METH vs METH p<0.01. TFP/SCH: F(5,30)=90.06, p<0.001; both p<0.001 vs METH.
outcomes.evidence: the 5 mg/kg psilocin group exhibited increased activity compared to the control group (p < 0.05) ... 1 mg/kg psilocin significantly inhibited METH- induced hyperactivity in mice ... (p < 0.01). However, 0.25 mg/kg psilocin did not significantly affect METH- induced hyperactivity.

B2_temporal_dynamics.evidence: Only total activity over the 1 h session reported; no time-binned analysis.

B3_sequential_structure.evidence: No transition or sequence analysis reported.

B5_social.evidence: Individual locomotor test; no social component.

B8_multivariate.evidence: One-way ANOVA with Bonferroni post hoc only.

D2_session_duration.evidence: monitored in an open- field for 1 h

assays.assay_description: Two-compartment CPP apparatus (white/grid vs black/mesh, 15×15×37 cm each, movable baffle). 15 min pre-test (day 1), acquisition conditioning days 2-9 (psilocin 1 mg/kg 30 min before METH 1 mg/kg), 15 min post-test day 10; extinction days 11-22 with 15 min tests on days 13,16,19,22; reinstatement 15 min test after METH priming ± psilocin. Also run with TFP-2HCl/SCH772984. Measure: CPP score.

application_type.evidence: the METH- Rein2 group was injected (i.p) with 1 mg/kg psilocin prior to METH injections

setup_habituation.evidence: Only a recorded pre-test is described: 'On day1, mice were pre- tested for 15 min.'

setup_restrain.evidence: During the test period, the mice was allowed to shuttle freely in the apparatus by opening the baffle

food_restriction.evidence: CPP apparatus with metal grid/mesh floors; no food described during 15 min tests

water_restriction.evidence: CPP apparatus; no water described during 15 min tests

time_to_assay.evidence: Post-test on day 10 after last drug pairing on day 9 (~24 h); extinction tests the day after psilocin injection (day 12 → day 13); reinstatement: 'injected with 1 mg/kg psilocin 30 min before METH injection' then tested.

sample_size.evidence: Figure 3: n = 5- 7; Figure 4: n = 5- 10; Figure 9: n = 7- 10

outcomes.summary: 1 mg/kg psilocin given before METH inhibited acquisition of METH-induced CPP; psilocin alone did not produce CPP. Psilocin did not alter extinction of METH CPP or block METH-primed reinstatement. TFP-2HCl and SCH772984 also blocked CPP acquisition.
outcomes.statistics: Acquisition: interaction F(3,20)=8.998, p<0.001; time F(1,20)=4.432, p=0.0481; treatment F(3,20)=13.34, p<0.001; psilocin+METH vs METH p<0.001. Extinction: interaction F(9,75)=5.177, p<0.001; time F(3,75)=3.535, p=0.0187; treatment F(3,75)=4.531, p=0.0114; Ext1 vs Ext2 n.s. Reinstatement: F(3,19)=18.39, p<0.001; Rein2 vs Rein1 n.s. TFP/SCH acquisition: interaction F(5,41)=3.135, p<0.05; time F(1,41)=15.53, p<0.001; treatment F(5,41)=2.917, p<0.05.
outcomes.evidence: injection of the 1 mg/kg psilocin before METH significantly inhibited the increase in CPP scores of the METH group (p < 0.001) ... However, psilocin did not impact METH extinction and relapse.

B6_cognitive.evidence: conditioned place preference (CPP) model — learned drug–context association

judge_notes: Two assays retained (open field locomotion; CPP). All candidates agreed on assay structure; acquisition/extinction/reinstatement and TFP/SCH variants collapsed into one CPP assay, and the three open-field cohorts into one OFT assay. Western blot excluded.
OFT D2: 1 h = 60 min falls in the inclusive 15–60 min bin (score 1); overrode gemma's score 2.
CPP D2: 15 min sessions score 1 per the rubric's inclusive 15-min boundary (qwen correct); overrode deepseek/gemma's score 0.
CPP D3: about 7 distinct test days (pre, post, 4 extinction tests, reinstatement) → 2-7 bin; rejected gemma's 15+, which counted conditioning days that were not recorded.
Dosing schedule set to 'repeated' (overriding the modal 'acute'): psilocin was given on 4 conditioning days in CPP acquisition. Acute dosing was used only in the OFT.
CPP time_to_assay set to 'multiple': post-test and extinction tests were about 24 h after dosing; reinstatement was acute (psilocin 30 min before METH, then tested).
OFT time_to_assay set to not_reported: the paper does not state the interval between injection and open-field recording.
